design.purpose: Fourfold path-count comparison after measured benefit from earlier guidance; fixed physical settings, new independent seeds, same four preselected source cells
design.cell_selection_rule: Original source cells nearest 30, 32.5, 35 and 37.5 degrees south; chosen before these runs

events.location: Klein Brak River, Mossel Bay, South Africa

limitations: Four-cell numerical control, not a replacement impact PDF.
The 540-day discovery-delay support and response law are retained as physical assumptions.
Ancestor concentration is diagnostic, not an independent-sample count or calibrated error bar.
The first baseline uses an archived seed for a direct numeric-preservation comparison; the second seed is new.
design.numerical_correction: Increase original paths from 1024 to 4096 per cell; compare both guidance starts with two new seeds. Pilot earlier guidance reduced between-seed centered log-score shape RMS from 2.9885 to 0.9597, but southern recovery ancestry remained concentrated.
